gated.why: the producer's settings, standing rules and taste notes
the colour language, Bob's look and colour
the harness: roles, commands, the session start hook
the health check's rules: how it runs
the health check's rules: which checks run, what stops a run
the gate itself: the logic the workflow runs
the health check's rules: where and when it runs
the health check's rules: what keeps docs, units and session logs in step
the health check's rules: where and when the in-step check runs
